test: R11 disjoint targets, same recipe. Already viewed development data; no claim independent prospective gain. No training on R11.
ranking: Full order enumeration, sum individual scan cost measured as number of shift score computations, then max individual cost, then tuple order. validation: Decision must equal full exact max >=9 in every test patch; each reported positive has exact score witness (recomputed independently); use full search if max track or top-K required.
